jaxdft is developed in conversation between Mads-Peter and Claude, in
[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). These pages show a few excerpts
of those conversations, chosen to show the different ways the work goes:
starting a milestone, settling an interface, learning the physics, testing a
speculative idea, and reviewing code.

The excerpts are taken from the session logs and are not edited. Messages
appear as they were written, typing errors included. Three things are left out
or shortened:

- **Tool calls** (commands, file edits, searches) are folded into a block
  between the messages, with one line per call. Their output is not shown.
- **The model's private reasoning** between messages is not shown.
- **Paths on the development machine** are shortened.

Each page starts with a short note on where the excerpt sits in the project
and what came of it.
